editorial:
Imagine falling in love in high school and promising you will never leave each other, only to have that love turn into something scary. You get to see exactly how that happens with Diane and David. They are both driven, smart students headed for military school, but their relationship is way too intense. When David admits he cheated, Diane doesn't just break up with him. Instead, she pushes him into a dark plan to get rid of the other girl. It feels like a slow-motion train wreck because you can see them making terrible choices while trying to act like the perfect couple.

The acting is surprisingly good for a TV movie, making the characters feel like real people rather than just villains. While some parts feel a bit slow, the tension builds up nicely until the crime actually happens. If you like true crime stories that show how pride and obsession ruin lives, you will love this. You can find this one for rent on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want it for your physical collection. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video too, so definitely go for the highest quality you can find to catch all the details.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the police start digging into the crime. The couple tries to lie their way out of it, but the evidence is too strong. In the end, Diane and David are arrested and convicted for the murder. You see the heartbreaking reality of their situation as they are sent to prison. They realize that their promise to be together forever led them to a place where they lost everything and their freedom.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime and psychological dramas.
